docs.purpose: Gives an admin a searchable, filterable, paginated directory of all user accounts, and lets an admin manually create a new supplier or enterprise account — creating their login, sending a password-reset link and setting up their profile — for accounts that are not self-service signups.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes `user_profiles`, `entitlements` and `admin_audit_log`. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/admin-users/api/useAdminUsers.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: GET (directory) is read-only with no audit row. Its column list is a hardcoded SQL fragment (DIRECTORY_COLUMNS) rather than a JS whitelist array, so projection is reported unmeasured per the strict rule; for transparency the SQL columns are user_id, email, phone_number, full_name, company_name, trade_slug, trade_slugs_override, account_preset, subscription_status, onboarding_complete, account_deleted_at, created_at. POST provisions a Supabase auth user (idempotent — adopts an existing email's auth account only with an explicit adopt_existing:true flag) plus a user_profiles row and a lead_gen entitlements row in one transaction, rolling back the Supabase user if the DB insert fails. Sets Cache-Control: no-store because the response can carry a live password-reset link. admin_key auth is forbidden from POST. Also cites 33_web_admin_engineering_protocol.md. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: EXTERNAL SERVICE CALLS (Supabase Admin API via createAdminClient, src/lib/supabase/admin.ts:23): auth.admin.createUser at :173; auth.admin.generateLink type 'recovery' at :218; auth.admin.deleteUser (rollback) at :278; auth.admin.listUsers (paginated by-email scan, PER_PAGE 200 x MAX_PAGES 25) at :336.
